```python
def get_coordinates(coord):
    x, y = coord
    return [[i, j] for i in range(x - 1, x + 2) for j in range(y - 1, y + 2)]
```

This returns the 3×3 block of coordinates around `coord`, including `coord` itself. The outer loop varies `i` (the first coordinate) more slowly, so the output is ordered lexicographically. For `(3, 4)` it produces `[[2, 3], [2, 4], [2, 5], [3, 3], [3, 4], [3, 5], [4, 3], [4, 4], [4, 5]]`, which matches the assertion. I did not run the assertion in this session.
